function.name: get_directory
function.description: List files and directories at a given path

path.description: Path to a directory (relative or absolute)

function.name: move_file
function.description: Rename or move a file and create missing destination directories. Existing destination files are protected unless overwrite is explicitly enabled.

source.description: Existing file to rename or move (relative or absolute path)

destination.description: Complete destination file path, including the new filename

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing destination file when true

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a UTF-8 text file and any missing parent directories. Existing files are protected unless overwrite is explicitly enabled.

path.description: Path of the file to create (relative or absolute)

content.description: Complete initial content of the file

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file when true

function.name: get_lines
function.description: Get the number of lines in a file

path.description: Path to a file (relative or absolute)

function.name: review_code
function.description: Get specific lines from a file by line number range

path.description: Path to a file (relative or absolute)

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Replace, insert, or delete lines in a file. All line numbers refer to the original file, before any edits are applied.

path.description: Path to a file (relative or absolute)

new_lines.description: List of line edits. Operation defaults to replace for backward compatibility. Include a trailing \n in content when the inserted or replacement text should end with a line break.

line.description: Target line in the original file (1-indexed). insert_before also accepts one line past the end to append.

operation.description: Edit operation. content is ignored for delete.

content.description: Text used by replace or insert operations. It may contain multiple lines.
